name: atlas.
source:
Mirai is an empathic witch and bookshop owner living with an auditory processing deficiency. As she navigates the challenges of her present, Mirai explores how her past may be intertwined with her future.

atlas. is a visual novel about diversity and acceptance: exploring community, relationships, and varying human perspectives.

[From [url=https://reannan13.itch.io/atlas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米莱是一位富有同情心的女巫和书店老板，患有听觉处理缺陷。当Mirai应对当前的挑战时，她探索了她的过去与未来如何交织在一起。

阿特拉斯。是一部关于多样性和接受性的视觉小说：探索社区、人际关系和不同的人类观点。

[来自[url=https://reannan13.itch.io/atlas]Itch.io[/url]]
